raw:
@q query
  mode count
  select ?total
  where any
    match
      relation "have"
      role subject "the user"
      role object "pigs"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "have"
      role subject "the user"
      role object "chickens"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "have"
      role subject "the user"
      role object "ducks"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "have"
      role subject "the user"
      role object "a goat"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end

@c constraint
  var ?total int
  require ?total equal 2 plus 14 plus 3 plus 1
  task prove
